annotations.title: Read what the AI assistant knows

description: Reads one AI assistant’s knowledge, named by id. view sources lists every source with its kind (file, text, website, Google place), status (queued, ready, failed), the reason a read failed, the website pages it could not load, and when it was last read; it pages with after and limit. view summary returns what the assistant learned: a short summary, the business name and one-line description read from the material, and suggested questions and answers awaiting a decision. Titles, summaries, questions and answers were read from websites and files by Cosend and come back marked untrusted. Read-only.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

view.description: sources lists the files, pasted texts, websites and Google places the assistant reads. summary reads “what I learned”: a short summary and the suggested questions and answers.

name: get_knowledge
title: Read what the AI assistant knows
